input: Find overnight, sleepaway and residential summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Brevard, Pisgah Forest, Rosman, Cedar Mountain, Lake Toxaway and Sapphire, NC (Transylvania County). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Brevard residential summer 2026 music center college camp

candidates.note: Boys’ overnight camp with outdoor adventures, sports and trips; 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: Camp High Rocks
candidates.note: Boys ages 7–16; one- to four-week overnight sessions, with 2027 registration open.

candidates.name: Camp Illahee
candidates.note: Christian girls’ camp for grades 2–11; residential sessions from five days to four weeks.

candidates.name: Camps Kahdalea and Chosatonga
candidates.note: Sister Christian residential camps: Kahdalea for girls and Chosatonga for boys, principally ages 8–17.

candidates.name: Keystone Camp
candidates.note: Girls’ residential camp with riding, sports, arts and outdoor activities; 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: Rockbrook Camp
candidates.note: Girls ages 6–16; overnight sessions with riding, crafts and outdoor adventures; 2027 dates published.

candidates.name: Gwynn Valley
candidates.note: Coeducational overnight camp with grade-specific sessions; 2027 registration open.

candidates.name: Ridge Haven
candidates.note: Christian residential camps for rising grades 3–12, including junior, junior-high and adventure weeks in 2026.

candidates.name: The Wilds Christian Association
candidates.note: The Wilds of North Carolina runs junior and teen overnight summer camps with Bible instruction and recreation.

candidates.name: Eagle’s Nest Foundation
candidates.note: Runs coeducational Eagle’s Nest Camp and teen Hante Adventures; 2027 residential camp dates published.

candidates.name: Green River Preserve
candidates.note: Coeducational nature-focused overnight camp and teen programs for grades 1–12; 2027 enrollment open.

candidates.name: YMCA of Greenville — Camp Greenville
candidates.note: Residential summer camp, adventure programs and leadership development for rising grades K–12; 2026 guide published.

candidates.name: Camp Merrie-Woode
candidates.note: Girls’ overnight camp with riding, boating, arts and outdoor adventures; 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: Pisgah Astronomical Research Institute
